events.title: British troops land at Kip's Bay and take New York
events.description: After a heavy naval bombardment, British forces landed on Manhattan at Kip's Bay, sending American troops fleeing. New York stayed in British hands until 1783.
events.html: After a heavy naval bombardment, British forces landed on Manhattan at Kip's Bay, sending American troops fleeing. New York stayed in British hands until 1783.

events.title: The Liverpool and Manchester Railway opens
events.description: The first inter-city railway relying wholly on steam locomotives opened with great ceremony. The day was marred when the MP William Huskisson was struck and killed by Stephenson's Rocket.
events.html: The first inter-city railway relying wholly on steam locomotives opened with great ceremony. The day was marred when the MP William Huskisson was struck and killed by Stephenson's Rocket.

events.title: HMS Beagle reaches the Galápagos Islands
events.description: Charles Darwin spent five weeks studying the islands' finches, tortoises and mockingbirds. His observations later helped shape his theory of evolution by natural selection.
events.html: Charles Darwin spent five weeks studying the islands' finches, tortoises and mockingbirds. His observations later helped shape his theory of evolution by natural selection.

events.title: Tanks go into battle for the first time on the Somme
events.description: British Mark I tanks supported an attack at Flers-Courcelette. Many broke down, but those that advanced showed the potential of armoured warfare.
events.html: British Mark I tanks supported an attack at Flers-Courcelette. Many broke down, but those that advanced showed the potential of armoured warfare.

events.title: The RAF repels massed daylight raids on Battle of Britain Day
events.description: The Luftwaffe launched two huge raids on London and lost around 60 aircraft. Two days later Hitler postponed his planned invasion of Britain indefinitely.
events.html: The Luftwaffe launched two huge raids on London and lost around 60 aircraft. Two days later Hitler postponed his planned invasion of Britain indefinitely.

events.title: UN forces land at Inchon
events.description: US Marines led General MacArthur's amphibious landing at Inchon, far behind North Korean lines. Seoul was retaken within two weeks and the North Korean army collapsed.
events.html: US Marines led General MacArthur's amphibious landing at Inchon, far behind North Korean lines. Seoul was retaken within two weeks and the North Korean army collapsed.
